title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of Vic's Liquor, Bossley Park

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths Limited proposed acquisition of Vic's Liquor, Bossley Park, NSW.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant markets to be: - the local market for the supply of liquor for off-premises consumption; - procurement markets; and - the national wholesale market.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The transaction results in a very small increase of market share to Woolworths in the procurement and wholesale markets.  Following the acquisition there will continue to be a number of independent liquor stores operating in the relevant local area.  For these reasons the acquisition is unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any market.
